shots.text: Mother Briar fell on the steps of Vesperhold, and the thorns that had grown through her went brown and crumbled.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: The thicket-woman falling apart on the floating steps, grey flowers wilting, black thorns crumbling.

shots.text: Tied in her thorns was my half-brother, Corvin. Six years ago he was found over a dead man, and I exiled him for murder. He had lived on the edge of the Rift ever since, watching the Gate.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Corvin the Uncrowned cutting himself free with a black glass blade, hood back, silver hair, a scar through his eyebrow.

shots.text:
Six years I told them it was the Marshal. Now they believe me.

The man I was exiled for killing saw Cassivane cut a piece off the Heartstone. That's why he died.
shots.speaker: corvin
shots.art_note: Corvin standing, looking at the player. Joins as a hero.
